errors.text: The proposed refractory-element addition does not reconstruct the target intervention of controlled in situ heating of equiatomic AuCoCuNiPt nanoparticles under vacuum.
No refractory element, concentration, alloy composition, particle size, or synthesis route is specified, so the intervention is not experimentally well-defined.
The asserted formation of a stable refractory phase is unsupported and could instead cause phase separation or chemical heterogeneity.
The mechanism conflicts with the target mechanism, which involves active diffusion, Au/Cu surface segregation, melting, and evaporation rather than grain-growth pinning.
No prior evidence is cited despite the explicit request for supporting evidence.
